subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write h. A tall line down, then up and over one hump. h, h, hand!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says h, as in hand.
This letter says h. Say the sound!
Trace h with your finger. Tall line down, then up and over the hump.
Look carefully. Which one is h? It is tall.

hints: h is tall, with one hump.
Start at the top. Go all the way down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write h for hand.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A short line down, then a hump. Look, I wrote h!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is n. h starts with a tall line.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Tall line down, then a hump. That is h!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter h, say its sound and trace it.
